Text.name: obj
Text.value: Draw a tight box around every vehicle in the image and answer Occlusion and Truncation for each box.

Text.name: d1
Text.value: Car: sedans, hatchbacks, SUVs, pickup trucks, minivans

Text.name: d2
Text.value: Bus: city buses, coaches, school buses, minibuses

Text.name: d3
Text.value: Truck: box trucks, lorries, semi-trucks (cab + trailer = one box), delivery/cargo vans

Text.name: d4
Text.value: Motorcycle: motorcycles, scooters, mopeds (box includes the rider)

Text.name: a1
Text.value: Occlusion: Yes if about 10% or more is hidden by another object (rider/trailer don't count)

Text.name: a2
Text.value: Truncation: Yes if part of the vehicle is cut off by the image edge

Text.name: r1
Text.value: 1. Box only the visible part, tight to the outline. One box per vehicle, even if boxes overlap.

Text.name: r2
Text.value: 2. Skip vehicles smaller than about 10x10 px or that you are unsure about.

Text.name: r3
Text.value: 3. Do NOT label bicycles, trains, reflections, shadows, vehicles behind glass, or vehicles in posters/screens.
